summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a voluntary transfer of its U.S. stock exchange listing from NYSE to Nasdaq Global Select Market, effective July 23, 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder vote are involved; the move is described as operational efficiency. The TSX listing remains unchanged. This is an ordinary exchange transfer, not a going-private, restructuring, or other special situation. Watch for smooth trading commencement on Nasdaq; no risk-arb angle.
